# Retkirasian numerolappu — bounded implementation card

2026-10-27. Next after actual observation acceptance; design pending, not completion.

Frozen M-NUM-QTY-NUMERAL is a process/representation node, requires M-NUM-02. Preserve that role and real compatible evidence qualification. Objective: associate visible quantities with decimal numerals, both directions. No written number-word recognition, object naming, Give-N construction or integration mastery is claimed. Scope3–6 follows the existing cardinality route; existing finite-process coverage requires eight direction/value decisions plus genuine correction application and a delayed sample. These are project design minima, not externally validated constants.

Purpose: “Valitaan rasioihin numerolaput.” Aava reuses the supplies already counted with Loikka. Show a whole set and its large numeral, then inverse direction without auto-selecting an answer. Guided keeps the supplied pair; fading removes it. Independent displays actual objects and plain numeral choices, or a numeral and distinct whole-set choices. No matching dots on numeral cards; no auto-total or quantity-giving speech. Two wrong labels become correction application, one decision at a time. An earlier saved group should appear in the supplies consequence without becoming a novel assessment merely by narrative reuse.
